usageDescriptions.camera: The capability demo takes a photo when you tap "Take photo".
usageDescriptions.photos: The capability demo shows your photo library permission status.
usageDescriptions.location: The capability demo shows your location when you tap "Current".
usageDescriptions.microphone: The capability demo shows how the microphone permission is requested.
usageDescriptions.biometric: The capability demo verifies you with Face ID when you tap "Authenticate".
